questions.question: Refer-a-friend: you get a bonus when a friend joins. Your friend usually…
options: Often gets a bonus too, so check both sides' terms
questions.explanation: Many schemes reward both sides.

questions.question: A legit survey site will never ask you to…
questions.explanation: Paying to join is a red flag.

questions.question: A game app pays £15 if you reach level 30 in 14 days. It takes about 25 hours. Your hourly rate?
questions.explanation: £15 ÷ 25 hours = 60p an hour.

questions.question: A survey site pays 40p per survey with a £5 minimum cash-out. Half your attempts get screened out. Roughly how many attempts to cash out?
questions.explanation: You need 13 completed surveys, so about 25 attempts.

questions.question: Survey A pays £1 for 10 minutes. Survey B pays £2.50 for 30 minutes. Which pays more per hour?
questions.explanation: A is £6/hour, B is £5/hour.

questions.question: Survey sites typically pay…
options: A few pence to a couple of pounds per survey
questions.explanation: It's pocket money for spare minutes.

questions.question: Before putting hours into a rewards app, check…
options: The minimum cash-out and recent payout reviews
questions.explanation: Some apps set cash-outs high enough that few people reach them.

questions.question: What helps you sell unwanted items faster and for more?
options: Clear photos and an honest description
The highest price you can think of
questions.explanation: Good photos and honesty build trust.

questions.question: What's the honest way to share referral codes?
options: Share where the rules allow, never spam or fake reviews
questions.explanation: Spam gets codes banned and communities annoyed.

questions.question: Using fake or duplicate accounts to claim referral bonuses is…
options: Against the terms, can be fraud, and leads to clawbacks or bans
Fine if the amounts are small
questions.explanation: Companies check for duplicate accounts.

questions.question: You miss a play-to-earn milestone deadline by one day. Usually you get…
questions.explanation: Deadlines are strict, so check them before you start.

questions.question: A “mystery shopper” job sends you a cheque to cash, asking you to wire part of it back. This is…
questions.explanation: The cheque bounces later and you lose the money you sent.

questions.question: A quick way to price something you're selling second-hand is to…
options: Check recently SOLD listings for the same item
questions.explanation: Sold prices show what people actually paid.

questions.question: Your freelance side work earns more than the £1,000 trading allowance in a year. You'll usually need to…
questions.explanation: Above the allowance, you generally need to report your income to HMRC.
questions.verify: Trading allowance and Self Assessment rules

questions.question: Before you start collecting points in a rewards app, check…
options: What the points are worth in £ and the minimum cash-out
questions.explanation: 10,000 points sounds great until you learn it's worth £1.

questions.question: A rewards app pays £1 per 1,000 points. You earn about 2,000 points an hour. What's your hourly rate?
questions.explanation: 2,000 points = £2 an hour, well below minimum wage.

questions.question: The Rent a Room scheme lets you earn up to how much a year tax-free from letting a furnished room in your home?
questions.explanation: Rent a Room relief is £7,500 a year.
questions.verify: Rent a Room relief on gov.uk

questions.question: For side gigs like tutoring or pet sitting, what helps clients trust you?
options: Reviews and, where relevant, checks like a DBS check
questions.explanation: Trust gets you repeat customers.

questions.question: An ad says “Work from home, earn £300 a day, no skills needed”. It's most likely…
options: A scam or a pyramid scheme
questions.explanation: If it sounds too good to be true, it usually is.

questions.question: In multi-level marketing (MLM) schemes, most participants…
questions.explanation: Studies and regulators have found most MLM participants make little or nothing after costs.
